standard.summary: 细粒度模块级 CPU offload 配置：按模块名称模式或参数量大小选择性地 offload 特定模块，比全量 offload 更精确。
standard.effect: backbone_ratio 控制基座模型权重的 offload 比例；te_ratio 控制文本编码器的 offload 比例；include/exclude_patterns 支持正则表达式精确控制。
standard.whenToUse: 需要精确控制哪些模块 offload 时（比 blocks_to_swap 更细粒度）。高级 VRAM 管理场景。
standard.avoidWhen: 不了解模型各模块结构时，使用更简单的 blocks_to_swap 或 gradient_checkpointing 即可。

standard_en.summary: Fine-grained module-level CPU offload configuration: selectively offloads particular modules by name pattern or parameter count, which is more precise than offloading everything.
standard_en.effect: backbone_ratio controls the offload ratio for the base model's weights; te_ratio controls it for the text encoder; include/exclude_patterns support regular expressions for exact control.
standard_en.whenToUse: When you need precise control over which modules get offloaded (finer-grained than blocks_to_swap). An advanced VRAM-management scenario.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you do not know the model's module structure -- the simpler blocks_to_swap or gradient_checkpointing will do.

advanced.principle: 模块 offload 通过 register_forward_pre_hook 和 register_forward_hook 在每次 forward 前/后执行 to(device) 操作。enhanced 模式增加异步传输和预取优化。min_param_mb 避免对小模块频繁传输（传输开销 > 节省收益）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 细粒度 offload 配置灵活但复杂；参数名 pattern 需要与实际模型的 module 命名匹配，建议先用 print(model) 查看模块结构。

advanced_en.principle: Module offload performs to(device) before/after each forward via register_forward_pre_hook and register_forward_hook. The enhanced mode adds async transfer and prefetch optimizations. min_param_mb avoids frequently moving tiny modules (transfer cost > savings).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Fine-grained offload configuration is flexible but complex; parameter-name patterns must match the actual model's module naming — print(model) first to inspect the structure.
